system_thesis_interpretation: PPC5r2 is a deliberately narrow four-assay benchmark, not a test of an end-to-end Experience Model. Its strongest scientific commitments are: D1A, candidate-conditioned supported-record selection by a READ-only adapter when the full external candidate set is supplied; D1B, behavioral dependence on interleaved responses along a constructed decisive path; D1C, the total effect of installing a frozen same-model DREAM-selected public-ledger view versus two prospective context policies; and D1D, the total effect of a frozen-DREAM root policy through evidence admission, training, READ selection, and action versus two prospective root policies. The frozen THINK/DREAM/ACT weights, append-only public ledger, all-assigned life-level reduction, adverse missing bounds, and explicit statement that the four-way intersection is not mediation are scientifically valuable constraints. They do not establish autonomous recall, closed-book storage, learned cognition, learned DREAM, continual improvement, abstraction, parenting, population effects, or scaling. On the current bytes, the assays are conceptually separable but not yet operationally identified enough for exact scientific preregistration because the proposal does not state which non-target components are frozen in each assay, and several estimand, reducer, and composite-testing rules remain deferred or ambiguous.
graph_delta_interpretation: The graph isolates the only learned artifact at the READER_TO_PROVIDER edge and puts path interventions downstream of provider selection, which is the right topology for preventing treatment-aware scoring. The PUBLIC_LEDGER and frozen DREAM view preserve a testable public-information boundary. However, causal isolation requires an explicit assay-by-component matrix that the graph does not supply. D1B must lock provider and adapter state; D1C must lock provider, adapter, response intervention, root policy, and SLEEP state; D1D must hold installed context policy and response interventions identical across root-policy arms; and D1A must specify whether it is a provider-only assay or includes policy-mediated querying. Without those bindings, effects can be attributed to interactions among simultaneously active graph edges rather than to D1A-D1D separately. D1D is especially vulnerable: if the DREAM_TO_SLEEP clone also receives authentic DREAM context while controls do not, its downstream-action contrast combines D1C and D1D. The RESPONSE_INTERVENTION topology supports causal perturbation of emitted responses, but a sealed nonmatch becoming a no-op needs an intervention-fidelity rule before the claim can say every edge was used. The graph also omits the benchmark-construction and run-lock stages that are permitted to use hidden truth to construct decisive paths and twins; their visibility and noninterference contracts must be explicit, even if they remain no-model stages.
loop_delta_interpretation: The minimal recurrent loop is unusually well constrained: deterministic debit precedence, canonical events, terminal replay, cold replay, immediate READ return before the next call, and no hidden free-text operations substantially reduce researcher and agent degrees of freedom. The scheduled single DREAM call shared across clones prevents between-arm stochastic DREAM realization from masquerading as a context/root-policy effect. The nominee-first SLEEP loop correctly makes assignment total and prevents realized-dose matching or fallback. Scientifically, these define treatment-policy ITT effects, not controlled direct effects. Exact inference still requires a predeclared coupling of stochastic THINK calls across within-life clones, or a clear independent-randomness assignment and analysis rule. The current prose also lacks a complete normative mapping from every loop terminal/status state to every arm-specific endpoint. In particular, DREAM_INVALID and DREAM_MISSING_NO_RETRY are named in the protocol but absent from the status-receipt enum; PUBLISH_EMPTY is prose rather than a distinct dream-result status; and TRAIN_FAILED, PROJECTION_REJECTED, ABSTAIN, MISSING, and VALID_EMPTY are not each mapped to numeric observed outcomes, direction-specific adverse imputations, or claim blockers. A generic WORST_CASE_BOUND label is insufficient for multi-arm contrasts unless it states, for each benefit direction, which arm receives the finite minimum and which receives the finite maximum.
claim_delta_interpretation: D1A has acceptable construct boundaries only as externally supported candidate discrimination. The literal release text should name the primary comparator, presumably the identical adapter-off provider, and characterize wrong-life and outcome-shuffled cells as specificity gates rather than alternative estimands. As written, outcome shuffling does not clearly perturb a causal input to atomic READ rows, whose targets are supported public responses rather than action outcomes, so that control may be inert by construction. D1B has a strong intervention set, but the evidence identifies behavioral necessity of emitted edge responses for action performance under this opaque-ID path world; it does not reveal private cognitive use. ONE_SHOT_READ may fail because downstream opaque identifiers cannot be queried before prior returns, so its contrast specifically identifies adaptive interleaved retrieval, not a general advantage of recurrent thought. The safest release language should report the intervention pattern rather than assert an unobserved mental process. D1C identifies the total effect of installing the DREAM-selected view, including DREAM-chosen cardinality, order, focus, prompt-token dose, budget consequences, and failure/abstention behavior. That is a valid policy estimand relative to recency and hash permutation if those policies are completely specified, but it is not a pure content-selection effect. D1D identifies an even larger policy package: root selection, admitted-row count, training tokens, updates, adapter size or validation success, inference behavior, and action. Because the protocol explicitly allows these doses and resources to differ, the current contrast cannot isolate root quality at fixed training dose or compute. Its release text must either say that assignment to the DREAM-root policy improved outcomes inclusive of induced dose/resource differences, or the benchmark must add a prospective fixed-dose/resource-matched contrast. For all claims, 'improved' needs a predeclared contrast, direction, margin, finite target population, uncertainty procedure, and corrected decision rule. The finite label is acceptable only as a literal intersection report accompanied by the non-mediation and forbidden-interpretation language; the title 'minimal identified mechanism' is stronger than the evidence if the four assays are never joined in a factorial or mediation design.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The runtime matrix is close to the intended causal firewall: model-visible state is public, provider scoring is blind to provenance and treatment, the DREAM call is assignment-blind, private eligibility is confined to SLEEP projection, and audit can reconstruct all inputs. Two issues remain. First, HIDDEN_TRUTH_PROBE_FUTURE is a compound information class marked derived_only at RESPONSE_INTERVENTION even though the reason says hidden truth is absent; a typed replacement may itself have been constructed from an oracle. The contract should separate hidden truth, future/probe material, and sealed intervention bytes so that forbidden source information cannot be laundered through a derived field. Second, the matrix excludes BENCHMARK_CONSTRUCTION, STATIC_SEAL/RUN_LOCK, TRAINER, and REDUCER as stages. Those stages can create paths, twins, assignments, margins, and claims and therefore need explicit read/write visibility rules. T07 and T13 test some construction properties but do not replace a total information-flow contract. Support leakage also needs a semantic-group audit: exact-tuple equivalence deduplication prevents byte-identical duplicates but does not by itself prevent paraphrase, alias, item-family, or donor overlap between ACQUIRE and PROBE from changing the intended generalization target.
acceptance_test_interpretation: T01 correctly enforces deliberation and authority but cannot certify scientific adequacy merely because artifacts agree. T02 is a strong syntactic and provenance sterility test; it also needs semantic-family and cross-split leakage vectors. T03 is sufficient for machine totality if the two implementations are genuinely independent. T04 covers total DREAM execution, but it cannot pass against the current contracts until invalid/missing/empty status encodings and reducer mappings are reconciled. T05 establishes common-interface candidate conditioning, not scientific improvement; it should additionally verify the exact target/support definition and every primary cue-family denominator. T06 is necessary for adapter isolation and prospective donors, but it does not ensure wrong-life comparability in evidence support, row dose, or training resources. T07 is strong for path topology; it also needs independent oracle validity, constructor visibility, and an audit that no model-visible byte encodes path position or action. T08 validates recurrence mechanics, but claim release needs presealed per-edge estimands, intervention-compliance/no-op thresholds, sham equivalence criteria, and quantitative pass directions. T09 validates total prospective context policies, but must bind cardinality, order, focus, token accounting, and whether induced budget/compute differences are part of the estimand. T10 validates total root policies, but must hold all non-root components fixed and either accept dose/resources as mediators of a policy-package effect or add a fixed-dose comparison. T11 is the pivotal scientific test yet is underspecified by the current life_reducer schema: there are no treatment/control contrast fields, randomization or paired-clone rule, margin, uncertainty method, assay-level composite p-value, safety-gate rule, per-status mapping, or missingness-limit denominator. T12 and T13 are sound authority and static-seal gates but do not cure an incomplete estimand. T14 is necessary for runtime integrity and literal claim control, but its broad expected result is not a self-contained causal-analysis specification. Therefore T01-T14 are a strong conformance suite but are not sufficient for scientific acceptance on the current bytes. Add pre-GPU acceptance artifacts for an exact assay/component matrix, an executable statistical analysis plan with calibrated synthetic null/alternative fixtures, complete status-to-ITT tables, and claim-specific construct/manipulation audits. The statistical fixtures should demonstrate familywise error control for four valid assay-level composite p-values, coverage under arm-specific missingness, no pseudoreplication of items/edges, and correct behavior at locked missingness and superiority/noninferiority boundaries.
assumptions: The recipient-life roster is the finite target population unless a superpopulation sampling mechanism is explicitly added; lower-level items, clones, and edges are repeated measurements, not independent sampling units.

Each D1 assay is intended to be run as a separate component assay with all non-target components fixed identically across its arms, even though the exact component-freezing matrix is not present in the normative bytes.

All treatment and control arms intended for a within-life contrast are prospective clones of the same eligible pre-treatment life state, and treatment assignment plus model-sampling seeds will be sealed before execution.
The complete semantic candidate table means the exact finite run-locked table supplied for each item, not all facts in an external world or closed-book model memory.
Intersection-union logic means every within-assay gate is required and the assay contributes one valid composite p-value to Holm; optional analyses never rescue a failed gate.
The word improved denotes a positive, pre-margined life-level ITT contrast with uncertainty, not an observed sample-mean difference alone.
No proposal, interpretation, or passing CPU/no-model fixture authorizes model inference, training, GPU work, behavioral treatment, or a scientific claim.

ambiguities.question: What exact provider, adapter, context policy, root policy, response-intervention state, SLEEP state, task set, and seed coupling is fixed in each D1A-D1D arm?
ambiguities.impact: Without a closed assay-by-component matrix, separate component effects are not identified and D1D downstream action can accidentally include D1C.

ambiguities.question: What are the exact treatment-control contrasts, finite target populations, weighting formulas, margins, uncertainty intervals, test statistics, and decision directions for every primary and safety endpoint?
ambiguities.impact: The current endpoint names and nested aggregation do not uniquely determine an estimand or reproducible claim decision.

ambiguities.question: Are all arms observed as paired clones within each life, randomly assigned across lives, or both, and how are stochastic model seeds coupled across arms?
ambiguities.impact: Randomization inference, standard errors, power, and the effective sample size depend on this choice; treating lower-level units as independent would be pseudoreplication.

ambiguities.question: What exact endpoint and blocker mapping applies to VALID_EMPTY, ABSTAIN, MISSING, PROJECTION_REJECTED, WRITER_EMPTY, TRAIN_FAILED, DREAM invalid/missing, CONSTRUCTION_FAIL, and RUN_INVALID in each arm and claim?
ambiguities.impact: All-assigned ITT and adverse missing bounds cannot be independently recomputed until every status has one arm- and endpoint-specific disposition.

ambiguities.question: How is the locked missingness limit calculated by arm and claim, and how are finite minimum/maximum outcomes assigned directionally when treatment, control, or both are missing?
ambiguities.impact: A generic worst-case label can still permit favorable or inconsistent imputation and undefined release behavior at the threshold.

ambiguities.question: How are D1A safety gates, D1B edge and recurrence gates, D1C two control contrasts, and D1D two co-primary endpoints combined into one valid assay-level p-value before Holm step-down?
ambiguities.impact: Holm controls the four-claim family only if each input p-value is valid for its full conjunctive claim; the current schemas do not define those composites.

ambiguities.question: Which field is permuted in OUTCOME_SHUFFLED_READER, and why should that permutation disrupt the supported READ-row signal rather than leave the training corpus unchanged?
ambiguities.impact: An inert negative control cannot support evidence specificity and may misleadingly appear to be a stringent control.

ambiguities.question: Does every-edge release mean a separately passing life-level contrast for each edge position and both CUT and TWIN, or one aggregate contrast over all edges, and what intervention-match rate is required?
ambiguities.impact: The phrase used every returned edge is unsupported if edge failures are averaged away or sealed hash nonmatches silently turn interventions into no-ops.

ambiguities.question: For D1C, what prospective cardinality do recency and permutation install, and are DREAM-selected cardinality, next-focus, prompt tokens, truncation, and downstream call-budget changes treatment components or nuisance variables?
ambiguities.impact: The contrast otherwise cannot distinguish context identity/order from context dose, focus, and resource effects.

ambiguities.question: Is D1D intended to estimate the total effect of the root-policy package with naturally varying admitted rows and compute, or root-selection quality at a fixed training dose?
ambiguities.impact: The current design identifies only the former, while selection-value wording can be read as the latter.

ambiguities.question: What semantic grouping, alias-family, item-family, and donor-overlap rules define ACQUIRE/PROBE separation beyond exact canonical-tuple equivalence?
ambiguities.impact: Paraphrase or family duplicates can create target leakage or change D1A from supported generalization into exact instance memorization without violating the exact-tuple check.

ambiguities.question: Which hidden-truth and target fields may benchmark constructors, twin generators, static sealers, run-lock builders, and reducers read, and which hashes prove those fields never enter model-visible bytes?
ambiguities.impact: The runtime visibility matrix cannot by itself rule out pre-runtime treatment leakage or oracle-derived identifiers.

ambiguities.question: What minimum detectable life-level effects, intra-life correlations, missingness scenarios, number of lives, and familywise power criterion will determine the run size before model execution?
ambiguities.impact: A four-claim all-pass intersection with many internal gates may have very low joint power even when individual effects are scientifically meaningful.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The existing T01-T14 suite is not sufficient to authorize a scientific run or literal claim on the current normative bytes.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: It verifies many software and information-flow invariants but does not freeze the per-assay component matrix, exact estimands, arm-specific ITT mappings, valid composite p-values, randomization/seed coupling, or calibrated operating characteristics.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Add normative CPU/no-model acceptance artifacts for the assay design matrix, executable analysis specification, exhaustive status-to-endpoint tables, and synthetic randomization/missingness/multiplicity calibration before any run lock can pass.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: D1D cannot currently be released as an isolated root-selection-quality claim because treatment-induced training dose and resources are explicitly allowed to vary.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The ITT contrast bundles selected identities with admitted-row count, tokens, updates, artifact publication, inference, and compute. Reporting resources does not remove those causal pathways or make selection quality a controlled estimand.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Either relabel D1D as the total effect of assignment to the DREAM-root training policy, inclusive of induced dose/resources, or add a separate prospective fixed-dose and resource-matched root-selection estimand; keep any dose-adjusted post-treatment regression exploratory.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The D1B literal phrase used every returned local edge risks implying observed private cognition beyond what the intervention identifies.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: CUT/TWIN effects identify behavioral necessity of emitted response bytes in this constructed task. ONE_SHOT_READ additionally tests adaptive interleaving under opaque identifiers, not recurrence in all senses.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Release the observable intervention result: action performance depended on each interleaved edge response and exceeded sham, one-shot, and open-loop controls on the presealed path benchmark; treat cognitive-use language as shorthand explicitly bounded to that result.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: OUTCOME_SHUFFLED_READER is not a scientifically interpretable specificity control until the proposal shows that the shuffled field causally enters positive READ-row construction.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The writer is defined to render READ requests and supported public responses from direct observations. Shuffling action outcomes may leave all READ rows and targets unchanged, producing an adapter equivalent to READER_LORA.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Define the exact permutation and its expected effect on row eligibility or targets, verify corpus hashes diverge while marginal dose is held, or replace it with a target-blind record-object/request pairing shuffle that destroys support while preserving row and token dose.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The protocol and closed contracts do not currently encode one consistent total status algebra for DREAM and SLEEP failures.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Protocol terms such as DREAM_INVALID, DREAM_MISSING_NO_RETRY, and PUBLISH_EMPTY have no direct corresponding closed status-receipt values, and downstream reducer behavior is not uniquely determined.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Reconcile the dream-result and status-receipt schemas with the protocol and publish an exhaustive cross-product table from raw stage result to installed bytes, debits, downstream execution, endpoint value or adverse bound, missingness flag, and claim blocker.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The literal D1A, D1C, and D1D release strings should state their comparator and finite benchmark scope, and the finite headline must always carry the no-mediation qualifier.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Improved without an explicit comparator invites baseline substitution; a headline-eligible four-component label can otherwise be read as evidence that the components jointly mediate an end-to-end learning loop.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Bind comparator-specific release strings to the exact life roster and accompany PPC5_FINITE_MECHANISM_ONLY everywhere with its forbidden-interpretation sentence; consider renaming it a four-assay intersection rather than an identified mechanism.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The visibility contract is not total for scientifically consequential pre-runtime and post-runtime stages.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Benchmark construction, twin generation, static sealing, run-lock construction, training, and reduction may read hidden truth or determine claims but are absent from the stage matrix; a compound hidden-truth/probe/future item also obscures which derivations are legal.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Extend the matrix with constructor, assignment/seal, trainer, and reducer stages; split hidden truth, probe/future, and sealed replacement bytes into separate information items; test the exact cartesian product before model execution.

open_questions: Should PPC5r2 be reworked before architecture ratification to bind the assay/component matrix, exact estimands, status mappings, and statistical composite rules?
For D1D, does the desired human-approved claim concern the total DREAM-root training-policy package or root-selection quality at fixed evidence and compute dose?
Should the D1B and finite-label release language be narrowed to observable intervention results and a non-mediational four-assay intersection?
Which exact proposal-only CPU/no-model scope, if any, may proceed after new consensus, while all model, training, GPU, behavioral, parenting, and scientific actions remain separately forbidden?
